settings.text: Ancient Romans prized liver above all else. Warriors consumed heart, testicles, and kidneys for strength—they knew something.

settings.text: Medical textbooks documented this for over a century: "like supports like." Consume heart, support your heart. Eat liver, optimize your liver. Testicular tissue builds testosterone.

settings.text: Then Big Pharma realized they couldn't patent organs. Medical schools stopped teaching it.

settings.text: Now doctors prescribe synthetic pills instead of the real thing—same science, better profit margins.
